failedBrowserAttempt.touchPolicy: held guard, actual dodge, recovery counters and early-windup interruption; prior dodge-only failures retained
failedBrowserAttempt.rawEvidence: browser-report.json in exact-revision artifact preserves the full callback samples, states and recording locators. Logs read; artifact ZIP digest reported by GitHub, not yet independently downloaded for this attempt.
failedBrowserAttempt.failureInterpretation: Actual defeat after1kill, second enemyHP32, playerposture122.68; not timeout or producer stop. Deadline assertion ran first and reported generic missing-victory wording; move mode assertion ahead of it while preserving the strict180second bound.

diagnosis.observed: Prior unit model delivered a new decision immediately at an update and did not simulate world progress between observation and touch commands.

independentReview.result: Confirmed lack of separated observation/command/rAF clocks and held-input/pulse lifetime. Independent FIFO-delay model:0.25s updates,0lagHP100victory,0.5slagHP28victory,0.75slag2kills/lastHP32defeat. Not an exact CI reproduction.

diagnosis.methodChange: Space with a dodge before close contact, hold guard for actual contact, then press close attacks. Remove narrow windup-stage dependency. Model observation/delivery/release while simulation continues at1/60, and record bounded real touch-command wall offsets. No game values or acceptance assertions changed.

producerDelayedModel.scope: Serial decision, delay before delivery,0.05s+delay held action/stick, then0.11s released action with guard held; simulation updated continuously at1/60. This is not the measured browser command distribution or every actual wait/rAF phase.
producerDelayedModel.oldPolicyExample: 0.1s delivery delay produced defeat in the bounded serial model; immediate delivery passed.
producerDelayedModel.limits: Longer-delay failure retained. No broad latency tolerance, real20battle result, physical-device performance or source-blind quality inferred.

diagnosis.followupReview: Independent reviewer found the first serial model treated movement as .05/.11 and combined guard/action delivery. Before CI, the model was corrected to separate guard commands and action/stick commands, use .05/.11 button, .10/.04 stick and .08 idle waits. Variable rAF phase and actual command-delay distribution remain unmodelled.

correctedBranchModel.scope: Separate state-return delay, guard-change command, action command(s), held/released waits at actual branch durations. Simulation continues in1/60steps, constant per-command illustrative delays.
correctedBranchModel.limits: Not a browser-time prediction, exact rAF/command trace replay or performance result.0.75s failure retained.
